description: Carefully evaluate and grade the Ramco ERP "Brain" chatbot's answers against the ground-truth question bank (BrainEvals-Layer1). Use this skill WHENEVER you are scoring, grading, judging, benchmarking, or running an evaluation of Brain answers — or when the user says "eval the brain", "score these answers", "run the evals", "grade against ground truth", "judge as correct/hallucination", or asks how well the Brain answers. Two rules define careful grading here and this skill enforces them: (1) drop two-word and otherwise low-quality/malformed questions from the eval set — they are not real questions; (2) an answer that is MORE comprehensive than the ground truth (a superset) is CORRECT, not a hallucination — a hallucination is ONLY inventing facts that are not there. Judge on informational equivalence of the important points, semantically, in English.
